name: Santee State Park
where: 251 State Park Rd, Santee, SC 29142 - I-95 exit 98 (SC-6 west, ~3 mi)
cost_note: Adults $3, ages 6-15 $1 (2x3 + 2x1). Pay at office, store or iron-ranger boxes.
kid_notes: Lake Marion shore. Trails: Limestone Nature Trail and Oak Pinolly Trail (each ~0.75-1 mi loop), Sinkhole Pond Trail 0.75 mi, and a 7.5-mi hike/bike loop with boardwalk sections. Operator pages do not mention a playground or fishing pier. Park closes 'dark' (~17:30); no Thanksgiving notice.

name: Santee National Wildlife Refuge (Bluff Unit: Santee Indian Mound / Fort Watson, Wright's Bluff Nature Trail)
where: 2125 Fort Watson Rd, Summerton, SC 29148 - I-95 exit 102 (US-15/301), ~1-2 mi
coord_source: Photon (OSM) refuge feature; visitor centre pin not checked
cost_note: No entrance fee listed on the FWS page.
kid_notes: Climb the Santee Indian Mound (Fort Watson site), 1-mi Wright's Bluff Nature Trail, free binoculars and backpacks on loan at the visitor centre. Some trails close 1 Nov-1 Mar (waterfowl sanctuary), and all trails close during deer-hunt days. Call to check hunt dates for 25 Nov.

name: Audubon Center & Sanctuary at Francis Beidler Forest
where: 336 Sanctuary Rd, Harleyville, SC 29448 - spur: I-26 exit 187 or I-95 exit 77; ~15-20 mi, roads not checked
cost_note: Adults 13+ $12, ages 6-12 $7 = $38. $1 off each ticket if bought online 24h ahead ($34).
kid_notes: 1.75-mi boardwalk loop through an old-growth cypress-tupelo swamp. Closed Thanksgiving Day, so Wednesday should be a normal day. Third-party pages give conflicting days (Tue-Sun, Fri-Sun, Thu-Sat); trust the operator page.

name: Adrenaline Monkey (indoor ninja/climbing park), North Charleston
where: 4950 Centre Pointe Dr Ste 100, North Charleston, SC 29418 - SPUR via I-26 East from I-95 exit 86 (~45-50 mi), near I-26/I-526
coord_source: Photon (OSM) address pin for 4950 Centre Pointe Dr (shared building)
cost_note: Prices not published anywhere I could reach. The operator site refused connections.
kid_notes: Ninja courses, warped walls, mega boulder wall, vertical climbing, obstacle maze, slides. Risk: the only hours found say weekdays open 15:30, which would rule out a lunchtime visit unless holiday-week hours apply. MapQuest also shows 'Closed'. Call (843) 278-5256.

name: Charles Towne Landing State Historic Site
where: 1500 Old Towne Rd, Charleston, SC 29407 - SPUR via I-26 East from I-95 exit 86 (~50 mi), then I-526 to SC-171
cost_note: Adults $12, ages 6-15 $7 = $38. Bike rental $8/person/hour.

facilities.name: Animal Forest (part closed Mon-Fri for construction)
Ship Adventure
facilities.note: away for winter maintenance from November

kid_notes: 6-7 mi of paved and unpaved trails, a reconstructed palisade and fortifications, bikes allowed. Animal Forest is partly closed on weekdays (puma and bear); red wolf, otter, skunk and tortoise stay open. Replica ship is away in November. No playground mentioned. Only Christmas closure listed.

name: Walterboro Wildlife Sanctuary (Great Swamp Sanctuary)
where: Detreville St, Walterboro, SC 29488 - I-95 exit 53 or 57, ~3 min
cost_note: Free.
kid_notes: Boardwalks, bridges and gravel bike/walk trails over braided creeks. Tourism page mentions the Henry Robinson Boardwalk with an observation tower, plus a stretch of the colonial Charleston-Savannah Stagecoach Road. Trail lengths not published. Earlier storm closures are old; no current notice found. City (843) 538-4353.

name: Colleton State Park
where: 147 Wayside Ln, Walterboro (Canadys), SC 29488 - I-95 exit 68, ~3 mi north
cost_note: Free.
kid_notes: Small park: Cypress Swamp Nature Trail to an Edisto River boardwalk overlook, plus a play field. No playground mentioned. Probably too small for 75+ min alone; pair it with Walterboro.

name: Hunting Island State Park (lighthouse climb, beach, nature centre)
where: 2555 Sea Island Pkwy, Hunting Island, SC 29920 - SPUR from I-95 exit 33 via US-17/US-21 through Beaufort (~45 mi)
cost_note: Park: adults $8, ages 6-15 $4 = $24. Lighthouse climb: $5 per person = $20, paid at the oil house.
kid_notes: 167 steps up the lighthouse (minimum height 44 in; under-14s need an adult), plus beach and nature centre. Lighthouse days not listed, and it closes in bad weather. The bridge to Boneyard Beach is temporarily closed for high tides. Large detour.

name: Savannah National Wildlife Refuge (Laurel Hill Wildlife Drive, Kingfisher Pond trails)
where: 694 Beech Hill Ln, Hardeeville, SC 29927 (US-17) - I-95 exit 5 (SC), ~7 mi
cost_note: No fee listed.
kid_notes: 4.5-mi drive on dikes with walkable and bikeable earthen dike trails (alligators likely) and single-track woodland trails at Kingfisher Pond. Visitor centre closes on federal holidays; Wednesday is not one.

name: Fort Pulaski National Monument
where: 101 Cockspur Island Rd, Savannah, GA 31410 - SPUR: I-95 exit 99, I-16 E 7 mi, I-516, US-80 E 13 mi
cost_note: $10 per person aged 16+, under-16s free = $20. Card only, no cash.

facilities.name: Wednesday before Thanksgiving (2023 precedent)
facilities.note: In 2023 the fort closed at 14:30 and the grounds at 15:00. No 2026 notice found.

kid_notes: Moated masonry fort with tunnels, casemates and ramparts to run on, cannon embedded in walls, plus McQueen's Island Trail. Federal shutdowns have closed it (Oct 2025). The hours page renders client-side and came back empty. Call (912) 219-4233.

name: Tybee Island Light Station & Museum (+ Tybee beach)
where: 30 Meddin Dr, Tybee Island, GA 31328 - SPUR beyond Fort Pulaski on US-80 (~3 mi further)
cost_note: 2025 prices: adults $14, ages 6-17 $12 = $52.
kid_notes: 178-step climb with landings every 25 steps; the beach is a few blocks away. Closed Tuesdays and Thanksgiving Day, so Wednesday should be open. Visit Tybee lists 'temporary' 10:00-15:00 hours, which conflicts with the operator.

name: Old Fort Jackson (cannon firing)
where: 1 Fort Jackson Rd, Savannah, GA 31401 - SPUR: I-95 exit 99, I-16 E to downtown, then President St/US-80 east (~14 mi)
kid_notes: Brick fort with a moat, ramparts and live cannon firings at 11:00 and 14:00. Closed Thanksgiving, Christmas Eve, Christmas and New Year's Day, so Wednesday should be open. Smaller than Pulaski; 75 min is about the most it fills.

name: Oatland Island Wildlife Center
where: 711 Sandtown Rd, Savannah, GA 31410 - SPUR: I-95 exit 99, I-16 E, US-80 E (~15 mi)
cost_note: Adults $7, ages 4-17 $5 = $24.
kid_notes: Walking loop through woods and marsh past native animals (wolves, bison, birds of prey, goats). Trail length not published; allow at least an hour. Closed Thanksgiving Day and the day after, but 25 Nov is not on the closure list. Open rain or shine. On the US-80 route to Pulaski and Tybee.

name: Skidaway Island State Park
where: 52 Diamond Causeway, Savannah, GA 31411 - SPUR: I-95 exit 94 (GA-204 east ~12 mi), then Diamond Causeway
cost_note: GA ParkPass $10 per vehicle.
kid_notes: Sandpiper Trail (~1 mi with salt-marsh boardwalks), Big Ferry Trail (2-3 mi loop with Civil War earthworks), 2 playgrounds. The Avian Trail and the tower are closed (bridge damage). Campground renovation runs Feb 2026 to Feb 2027.

name: Wormsloe State Historic Site
where: 7601 Skidaway Rd, Savannah, GA 31406 - SPUR: I-95 exit 94 (GA-204 east ~10 mi)
coord_source: Photon (OSM) site woodland polygon; gate is on Skidaway Rd
kid_notes: A 1.5-mi live-oak avenue, tabby fort ruins and the colonial life area (demonstrations only at events). The operator page as fetched says the nature trail is 7 miles; check this. Closed Thanksgiving and Christmas Day. Less of a run-around than Skidaway, which is 5 min away.

name: Exhilarate - The Adventure Zone (indoor trampolines, ninja, climbing)
where: 105 Tibet Ave, Savannah, GA 31406 - I-95 exit 94 (GA-204 east ~7 mi, off Abercorn)
coord_source: Photon (OSM) Tibet Ave street segment, approximate
cost_note: No price list found; no operator site resolved.
kid_notes: 35,000 sq ft indoor centre: trampoline arena, ninja courses, climbing walls, mega play structure. Directory activity suggests it was operating in April 2026. Phone numbers conflict: 912-299-3900 and 912-777-4026. Call.

name: Sky Zone Trampoline Park Savannah
where: 3609 Ogeechee Rd Ste B, Savannah, GA 31405 - I-95 exit 94 or 99, ~10 mi
coord_source: Photon (OSM) Ogeechee Rd street segment, approximate
cost_note: Not published; skyzone.com/savannah returned 404.
kid_notes: Trampoline park in the former DEFY building. The operator URL 404s and MapQuest shows 'Closed', so it may have closed. Treat as unverified.

name: Fort McAllister State Park
where: 3894 Fort McAllister Rd, Richmond Hill, GA 31324 - I-95 exit 90 (GA-144 east ~10 mi)
cost_note: ParkPass $10 per vehicle, plus fort/museum: adults $9.75, ages 6-17 $5.50 = $30.50. Total ~$40.50 + tax. Whether fort admission waives parking is not stated.
kid_notes: Grass-covered Civil War earthwork fort with bombproof, cannon and tunnels to explore. Red Bird Creek Trail 3.2 mi and Magnolia Trail 1.1 mi, both open to hikers and bikes, plus a playground. No holiday notice.

name: J.F. Gregory Park
where: 521 Cedar St, Richmond Hill, GA 31324 - I-95 exit 87 (US-17 / Ford Ave), ~3 mi
cost_note: Free.
kid_notes: 335-acre city park with a large playground, a 3-mi paved loop around old rice fields (bikes OK), a huge covered pavilion and restrooms. Cheap leg-stretch near the interstate; the city sometimes closes the trail for maintenance.

name: Fort Morris State Historic Site
where: 2559 Fort Morris Rd, Midway, GA 31320 - I-95 exit 76 (US-84 east ~7 mi)
cost_note: Mon-Thu self-guided: $5 per vehicle at the collection box. Full admission Fri-Sun.
kid_notes: Revolutionary War earthwork fort on a river bluff with a nature trail. Museum closed on Wednesdays. Small: about 45-60 min. Exit 76 is also where they leave I-95 for US-84.

name: Okefenokee Swamp Park (Waycross entrance)
where: 5700 Okefenokee Swamp Park Rd, Waycross, GA 31503 - off US-84/US-1 at Waycross, ~8-10 mi south
cost_note: General admission: adults (12+) $25, ages 4-11 $24 = $98. 3-Hour Experience with boat ride: $35 and $30 = $130. FAQ says 'plus tax'. Walking-only All Access $18 per person.
kid_notes: Train ride, boardwalks with alligators, Pioneer Island, reptile show, optional naturalist boat ride. Tower closed. Contradiction: the guided-tours page lists boat tours only from Folkston, but the 3-Hour Experience at Waycross includes a boat ride. Fair amount of sitting (train, boat). No holiday info; call (912) 283-0583.

name: Laura S. Walker State Park
where: 5653 Laura Walker Rd, Waycross, GA 31503 - off US-84/US-82 at Waycross, GA-177 ~9 mi SE
cost_note: GA ParkPass $10 per vehicle.
kid_notes: Lake, 4 mi of trails (names and lengths not published; the trails page 404s), wildlife-observation boardwalk, playground. 5 min from the Swamp Park.

name: Lynches River County Park & Environmental Discovery Center (canopy walk)
where: 5094 County Park Rd, Coward, SC 29530 - from I-95 at Florence, ~15 mi SE (exit not checked)
cost_note: Admission not published on the page fetched.

facilities.name: Environmental Discovery Center and canopy walk

kid_notes: Elevated canopy walk, river boardwalk, Kids in Parks TRACK Trail, climbing wall (call for status). Closed Thanksgiving Day only. Earlier on the route (Florence) than the stated 10:30-13:30 window; listed for breadth. Splash pad is summer only.

name: Little Pee Dee State Park
where: 1298 State Park Rd, Dillon, SC 29536 - I-95 exit 193 (Dillon), ~10 mi SE
cost_note: Free.
kid_notes: 3.6 mi of trails around a lake; swimming area closed for the season. Too early on the route for the lunch window; listed for breadth.

name: Clark's Restaurant (since 1946)
where: 114 Bradford Blvd, Santee, SC 29142 - I-95 exit 98
cost_note: Prices not checked.
kid_notes: Sit-down Southern; family-run since 1946. Thanksgiving Day is breakfast and lunch only, so Wednesday should be normal. Kids menu not stated. (803) 854-2101.

name: Santee Seafood Bistro
where: 648 Bass Dr, Santee, SC 29142 - I-95 exit 98
coord_source: not geocoded; OSM has 'Santee Steak & Seafood' nearby, possibly not the same place
kid_notes: Family-owned seafood and comfort food. Hours come from a 2023 tourism page.

name: The Breakfast Nook
where: 9054 Old Number Six Hwy, Santee, SC 29142 - I-95 exit 98
kid_notes: Quick counter-style breakfast and lunch with a large menu.

name: Food Lion (picnic supplies)

kid_notes: Grab-and-go supplies for a lakeside picnic at the park's shelters.

name: Dukes Barbecue (buffet)
where: 949 Robertson Blvd, Walterboro, SC 29488 - I-95 exit 57/53
cost_note: Buffet price shown only as an image.
kid_notes: All-you-can-eat SC buffet (pulled pork, fried chicken, mac and cheese, banana pudding); smoker running since 1985. Closed Mon-Tue. (843) 549-1446.

name: Hiott's Pharmacy soda fountain
where: 373 E Washington St, Walterboro, SC 29488 - I-95 exit 53/57
kid_notes: DESTINATION: 80+-year-old downtown drugstore with a soda-fountain counter (floats and shakes). Whether it serves lunch is not confirmed. (843) 549-7222.

name: Fat Jack's
where: Walterboro, SC (OSM: Cycle Ln) - I-95 exit 57
kid_notes: Family-run sit-down (steaks, wings, shrimp) with rotating lunch specials.

name: Chick-fil-A (Centre Pointe Dr, next to Tanger Outlets)
where: 4926 Centre Pointe Dr, North Charleston, SC

facilities.name: Restaurant
facilities.note: store page not found; chain closed Sundays, Wednesday normally open

kid_notes: Quick counter next door to Adrenaline Monkey; Tanger Outlets (4840 Tanger Outlet Blvd) is across the road.

name: Publix (picnic supplies / deli subs)
where: 1401 Sam Rittenberg Blvd, Charleston, SC
kid_notes: ~1 mile from Charles Towne Landing. Deli subs for a picnic; whether the park has picnic areas was not checked.

name: Sandfly BBQ
where: 8413 Ferguson Ave, Savannah, GA 31406 - I-95 exit 94
kid_notes: Casual counter BBQ about 1 mile from the Wormsloe gate, on the way to Skidaway. The downtown Streamliner location has closed.

name: Kroger (Diamond Causeway) - picnic supplies
where: 7 Diamond Causeway, Savannah, GA 31411
kid_notes: On the causeway into Skidaway SP; picnic at the park's playground and shelters.

name: Wiley's Championship BBQ
where: 4700 US-80 E, Savannah, GA 31410 (Whitemarsh Island)
cost_note: Kids' meals (12 and under) $8 including side and drink.
kid_notes: Competition BBQ on US-80, between Oatland and Fort Pulaski/Tybee. Kids' menu: chicken fingers, corn dog, mac and cheese, grilled cheese. Holiday hours not listed.

name: The Crab Shack (Gator Lagoon, aviary)
where: 40 Estill Hammock Rd, Tybee Island, GA - off US-80 just before Tybee

facilities.name: Restaurant
facilities.note: hours not published; site says walk-ins welcome every day

kid_notes: DESTINATION: outdoor seafood shack over the marsh. Gator Lagoon with ~78 baby alligators (buy gator food), an aviary and a game shack; low-country boil. Opening time not published: call 912-786-9857.

name: Huc-A-Poo's Bites & Booze
where: 1213 US-80, Tybee Island, GA 31328
cost_note: Site lists slices $5, kids' slice $3, kids' hot dog $2. The menu may be old.
kid_notes: Casual pizza-by-the-slice joint near the lighthouse. It is also a bar.

name: Tybee Market IGA (deli lunch specials)
where: 1111 Butler Ave, Tybee Island, GA 31328
kid_notes: Grab-and-go deli for a beach picnic.

name: Leopold's Ice Cream (Broughton St)
where: 212 E Broughton St, Savannah, GA
kid_notes: DESTINATION: century-old Savannah ice-cream parlour. Dessert, not lunch; opens at noon.

name: Bubba's Bistro
where: 3881 US-17, Richmond Hill, GA 31324 - I-95 exit 87
kid_notes: Sit-down coastal Southern with a backyard seating area; Explore Georgia tags it family-friendly. Kids menu not stated. (912) 756-3535.

name: Parker's Kitchen (US-17 at Ford Ave)
where: 2341 Hwy 17, Richmond Hill, GA - I-95 exit 87
coord_source: Photon (OSM) 'Parker's Gas Station, Ford Ave', probably this store
kid_notes: Grab-and-go Southern hot food (the regional chain is known for fried chicken) for a picnic at J.F. Gregory's pavilion.

name: Kroger Richmond Hill (picnic supplies)
where: 53 Exchange St, Richmond Hill, GA
kid_notes: Supplies for a picnic at J.F. Gregory or Fort McAllister.

name: Fish Tales at Fort McAllister Marina
where: 3203 Fort McAllister Rd, Richmond Hill, GA - on the road to the fort
kid_notes: Riverside marina setting next to the fort. Listed hours say Wednesday is dinner-only (16:00), so likely not a lunch option; sources conflict. (912) 727-3473.

where: 5700 Okefenokee Swamp Park Rd, Waycross, GA
kid_notes: On-site snacks. Menu and hours not published.
